_comment: Closed-loop 3D PPO on the VALIDATION window val_a (Sionna RT at the ns-3 frequency -> obstruction matrix -> ns-3 -> measured per-user PDR -> next PPO observation). Set ppo.checkpoint to the pilot model (models/ppo_multiuav_3d/<run>/best_val_model.zip or model.zip). The default controller config (configs/closed_loop_control.json) is unchanged and still rule-based.
